bio.text: Edward Braunstein has represented the 26th Assembly District in northeast Queens since he was elected in 2010, and chairs the Assembly Committee on Corporations, Authorities and Commissions.
He was born and raised in Bayside and lives in Bay Terrace.
Braunstein received a B.S. in Finance from the University at Albany, attended New York Law School, and previously worked as a legislative assistant in the Assembly Speaker's New York City office.
